title: Terms of Use
html:
Terms of Use

These draft Terms of Use apply to access and use of the Advantage Data Vision website and publicly available product information. By using this website, you agree to use it only for lawful, professional, and informational purposes.

Website Content

Content on this website is provided for general information about ADV, our research direction, and our medical technology products. It is not medical advice, clinical instruction, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, or a substitute for independent professional judgment.

Product Information

Descriptions of virtual patient simulation systems, personalized deep features, real-world data search, AI models, risk stratification, and clinical decision support are subject to further validation, regulatory review, project-specific agreements, and institutional approval before clinical deployment.

User Responsibilities

You must not misuse the website, interfere with its operation, upload unlawful content, attempt unauthorized access, or submit patient-identifiable information through public contact forms unless ADV has expressly provided a secure and approved channel.

Intellectual Property

Website text, images, product descriptions, diagrams, logos, and related materials belong to ADV or their respective owners and may not be copied or reused without permission, except as allowed by applicable law.

Changes

ADV may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the website after updates means you accept the revised terms.
